name: log1p
expr: r = log1p(x); rs = log1p(-2); rc = log1p(xc); rz = log1p(z); rinf = double(isinf(log1p(-1)));
comment: Sig: r = log1p(...). log1p(x)=log(1+x). For x<-1 the argument is negative so MATLAB returns complex (log1p(-2)=i*pi); any array element <-1 promotes the whole real array to complex, accurate per element (log1p kept for x>=-1, so r(3)=1e-10 stays accurate, not the lossy log(1+1e-10)). Complex input uses log(1+z): log1p(3+4i)=1.732868+0.785398i. log1p(-1)=-Inf. Complex branches added 2026-06-05 (bugs/builtin/gradient-3d sibling: bugs/builtin/log-complex-promotion-arrays.md, log1p follow-up). Real in-domain part is the original spec-extension batch 2026-05-09.
